study: Post-hoc diagnostic of calibration-to-test threshold transfer
trigger: After observing high sensitivity but low test specificity in the completed original512 study. This is explanatory follow-up, not independent confirmation or deployment threshold selection.
rule: Set classification logit threshold using only calibration negatives: highest allowed false-positive count=floor((1-target)*n_negative). Threshold is nextafter the next descending negative logit toward +infinity, conservative for ties. Positive iff logit>=threshold, float64 comparisons.
bootstrap: 2000 independent calibration-group and test-group resamples, seed20261123; refit threshold in each calibration resample, evaluate its paired test resample
report: All thresholds, achieved calibration specificity, test sensitivity/specificity and below-target fractions; model logits, weights and existing CoreML export remain fixed. Descriptive intervals, not clinical guarantees. Repeatedly studied source family, imperfect filename-derived groups.
